route_a2a_agent_request: route an A2A agent request by looking up the agent in the registry and injecting its API base URL into the request data
test_route_a2a_agent_request_non_a2a: test route_a2a_agent_request returns None when the model name does not start with a2a/
test_route_a2a_agent_request_not_found: test route_a2a_agent_request raises ProxyModelNotFoundError when the agent is not found in the registry
test_route_a2a_agent_request_forbidden: test route_a2a_agent_request raises HTTPException 403 when the user is not allowed to access the agent
test_route_a2a_agent_request_injects_api: test route_a2a_agent_request injects the agent's API base URL into the request data and calls litellm
